description: This Java source file defines the 'PolicyEntriesModified' event class used within the Eclipse Ditto project. It represents an event emitted after multiple policy entries are modified at once, includes methods for creation from JSON, and manages policy entries data.

classes.name: PolicyEntriesModified
classes.description: An immutable event class representing the modification of multiple policy entries at once. Provides various factory methods for creation from JSON or explicit parameters, and overrides methods for JSON serialization and equality.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods for creating instances of PolicyEntriesModified, supporting different parameter sets including deprecated ones.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance from a JSON string or JSON object, parsing the event details.

methods.name: getPolicyEntries
methods.description: Returns the iterable of modified PolicyEntry objects.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Serializes the policy entries into a JSON entity according to schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer indicating the resource path within the event JSON.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Creates a copy of the event with a new revision number.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a copy of the event with new Ditto headers.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends policy entries payload to a JSON object builder based on schema version and filtering predicate.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code for the event object.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality between this event and another object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the event.
